entries.claim: Historical English basis of the Collect through this missal, revised against the Latin in contemporary language: the thief (latro), the fruit of Your mercy (tuæ propitiatiónis efféctum), rendered to each a different recompense according to his deserts (divérsa utrísque íntulit stipéndia meritórum), taking away the error of our former life (abláto vetustátis erróre), He may bestow (largiátur); the conclusion written out. Additional line revision: et Iudas through sumpsit (w004–w014) is one subject/recipient/recompense construction; both Judas received punishment and the thief reward.
